description: Angular component for managing alarm assignee UI, including displaying assignee info and opening an overlay panel for reassignment.

classes.name: AlarmAssigneeComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying and managing alarm assignee information, including opening a panel for reassigning alarms.

methods.name: getAssignee
methods.description: Returns display name of the alarm assignee or a translated string if unassigned or deleted.

methods.name: getUserInitials
methods.description: Returns initials of the alarm assignee.

methods.name: getAvatarBgColor
methods.description: Generates a background color for the avatar based on the assignee's display name.

methods.name: openAlarmAssigneePanel
methods.description: Opens an overlay panel to reassign the alarm, attaching the AlarmAssigneePanelComponent.
